in_hebrew.name: Juliette
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Jewel, little one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Juliette הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin 'julia' meaning 'downy-haired, youthful'. The name Juliette is derived from Julius, which is a Roman family name meaning 'youthful one'. It is also derived from the Latin 'julia', meaning 'youthful one', 'downy-haired' or 'soft-haired'. In the Bible, there is a woman named Juliette mentioned in the Book of Luke (8:2-3) as one of the women who followed Jesus and supported Him and His disciples financially. In Christian tradition, St. Juliette is also known as St. Juliana of Nicomedia, a martyr who was tortured and killed for her faith.
